name: cf-conventions
label: CF Conventions (Climate)
description: Climate and Forecast metadata conventions — atmospheric science, climate modeling

table_notes.cf_variable: Reference table of CF Standard Names defining physical quantities, their canonical SI units, and AMIP/GRIB cross-references.
table_notes.cf_dataset: One row per ingested netCDF/HDF5 dataset file, capturing provenance metadata (institution, source model, history) and the spatial/temporal envelope.
table_notes.cf_observation: High-volume point-observation records linking a dataset and variable to a single spatio-temporal measurement with uncertainty and quality flag.
table_notes.cf_grid_metadata: Describes the horizontal/vertical grid geometry of a gridded model output dataset, including projection and resolution details.

cf_variable.name: id
cf_variable.description: Surrogate integer key for the CF standard name entry

cf_variable.name: standard_name
cf_variable.description: Canonical CF Standard Name token (e.g. air_temperature, eastward_wind)

cf_variable.name: canonical_units
cf_variable.description: SI unit string for this quantity as defined by CF (e.g. K, m s-1, Pa)

cf_variable.name: description
cf_variable.description: Human-readable definition of the physical quantity from the CF standard names table

cf_variable.name: amip
cf_variable.description: AMIP II short variable name for this quantity (atmosphere model intercomparison coding)

cf_variable.name: grib
cf_variable.description: GRIB parameter code corresponding to this CF variable (WMO GRIB1/GRIB2 table entry)

cf_dataset.name: id
cf_dataset.description: UUID primary key for the dataset record

cf_dataset.name: title
cf_dataset.description: Human-readable title of the dataset as stored in the global title attribute

cf_dataset.name: institution
cf_dataset.description: Name of the organisation that produced or archived this dataset

cf_dataset.name: source
cf_dataset.description: Model or instrument description (maps to CF global attribute source)

cf_dataset.name: history
cf_dataset.description: Audit trail of processing steps applied to the file (CF global attribute history)

cf_dataset.name: ref_notes
cf_dataset.description: Bibliographic references (papers, DOIs) associated with this dataset

cf_dataset.name: conventions
cf_dataset.description: CF convention version string declared in the file (e.g. CF-1.8, CF-1.11)

cf_dataset.name: created_at
cf_dataset.description: Timestamp when this dataset record was inserted into the database

cf_dataset.name: file_url
cf_dataset.description: URL or object-storage path to the source netCDF/HDF5 file

cf_dataset.name: spatial_extent
cf_dataset.description: PostGIS polygon of the dataset's geographic bounding box (WGS84) for spatial filtering

cf_dataset.name: time_start
cf_dataset.description: First timestamp covered by this dataset (inclusive)

cf_dataset.name: time_end
cf_dataset.description: Last timestamp covered by this dataset (inclusive)

cf_observation.name: id
cf_observation.description: Auto-incrementing bigint key for high-volume observation rows

cf_observation.name: dataset_id
cf_observation.description: References cf_dataset.id — the source file this observation was extracted from

cf_observation.name: variable_id
cf_observation.description: References cf_variable.id — identifies the physical quantity being measured

cf_observation.name: time
cf_observation.description: UTC timestamp of the observation or model output time step

cf_observation.name: latitude
cf_observation.description: WGS84 latitude of the observation point in decimal degrees

cf_observation.name: longitude
cf_observation.description: WGS84 longitude of the observation point in decimal degrees

cf_observation.name: altitude_m
cf_observation.description: Altitude above mean sea level in metres (NULL for surface observations)

cf_observation.name: value
cf_observation.description: Measured or modelled value in the canonical units of the referenced cf_variable

cf_observation.name: uncertainty
cf_observation.description: One-sigma measurement uncertainty in the same units as value (NULL if unknown)

cf_grid_metadata.name: id
cf_grid_metadata.description: Surrogate key for the grid definition record

cf_grid_metadata.name: dataset_id
cf_grid_metadata.description: References cf_dataset.id — the dataset whose grid geometry this row describes

cf_grid_metadata.name: grid_type
cf_grid_metadata.description: Grid topology type (e.g. regular_lat_lon, rotated_pole, gaussian, curvilinear)

cf_grid_metadata.name: lat_min
cf_grid_metadata.description: Southernmost latitude of the grid domain in decimal degrees

cf_grid_metadata.name: lat_max
cf_grid_metadata.description: Northernmost latitude of the grid domain in decimal degrees

cf_grid_metadata.name: lon_min
cf_grid_metadata.description: Westernmost longitude of the grid domain in decimal degrees

cf_grid_metadata.name: lon_max
cf_grid_metadata.description: Easternmost longitude of the grid domain in decimal degrees

cf_grid_metadata.name: lat_resolution
cf_grid_metadata.description: Grid spacing in the latitude direction in decimal degrees

cf_grid_metadata.name: lon_resolution
cf_grid_metadata.description: Grid spacing in the longitude direction in decimal degrees

cf_grid_metadata.name: num_levels
cf_grid_metadata.description: Number of vertical levels (pressure levels, sigma levels, or model layers)

cf_grid_metadata.name: projection
cf_grid_metadata.description: Coordinate reference system name or PROJ string (e.g. EPSG:4326, lcc, stere)

short_description: Climate and Forecast metadata conventions — atmospheric science, climate modeling
long_description: CF (Climate and Forecast) Conventions define the metadata standards for scientific atmospheric, oceanic, and climate data stored in netCDF files. The schema captures CF Standard Name definitions for physical quantities, gridded dataset metadata with projection information, individual observation records with quality flags, and spatial grid configuration.
when_to_use: Use for climate analytics platforms, weather data management systems, environmental monitoring tools, or any scientific computing application handling atmospheric/oceanographic data. Used by every major climate modeling center (ECMWF, NCAR, NOAA, Met Office). Required by CMIP6 (the data source for IPCC AR6) and Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) for data submissions.
